{
  "thinking": "Empty table, 10 minutes left, and nobody has picked up the pad yet. I'll claim it and sketch a simple fish with a tail fin, so we have a plan before anyone starts placing dominoes.",
  "say": "Okay, I'm grabbing the pad. Let's do a fish, side view, with the tail fin sticking out. I'll put the start at the back end, by the tail, so the run flows toward the nose. Shout if you'd rather do something else!",
  "to": "everyone",
  "eagerness": 8,
  "point": [4, 10],
  "pad": "take",
  "sketch_clear": true,
  "sketch": [
    {"type": "label", "x": 4, "y": 10, "text": "START"},
    {"type": "curve", "points": [[4,10],[8,7],[14,6],[20,7],[25,9],[28,10],[25,11],[20,13],[14,14],[8,13],[6,11]]},
    {"type": "line", "x0": 8, "y0": 7, "x1": 2, "y1": 4},
    {"type": "line", "x0": 8, "y0": 13, "x1": 2, "y1": 16},
    {"type": "label", "x": 22, "y": 9, "text": "eye"}
  ],
  "do": "stop",
  "notes": "Round 1 start. I hold the pad. Plan: fish side view. Stroke 1 = body outline from START (tail base, ~4,10) along top to nose (~28,10) and back along bottom. Strokes 2 and 3 = tail fin lines branching off body top and bottom near the tail. Eye label at ~22,9. Next: get stroke 1 traced first (someone must start from START), then fins. Ask who wants to trace what."
}
